clusters.name: Drug and provider cost/pricing
clusters.coverage_basis: deployed sitemap route classification; overlaps with insurance, oral, and comparison clusters
clusters.gap: There is coverage, but no single drug-by-provider cost pillar with a complete cash-price, recurring-price, fee, insurance, and source-date matrix. KD is missing for four head terms in the current receipt.

clusters.name: Coupons, savings cards, and manufacturer assistance
clusters.gap: Zepbound is covered, but Mounjaro and Ozempic have no dedicated coupon/savings-card pillar routes; assistance versus savings needs a unified hub with eligibility and date boundaries.

clusters.name: Oral GLP-1 and pill options
clusters.gap: One Wegovy-pill page exists. It needs a pillar plus five spokes covering approval/status, oral-versus-injectable cost, insurance, access, and what is actually available; no second oral anchor is measured yet.

clusters.name: Drug-versus-drug and approved-versus-compounded comparisons
clusters.coverage_basis: drug-specific guide routes only; provider and assistance comparisons excluded from this count
clusters.gap: Mounjaro/Ozempic has a pillar; Ozempic/Zepbound and Wegovy/Mounjaro remain uncovered as dedicated comparison intents. Every comparison must stay label-, indication-, and evidence-bound.

clusters.name: Provider-versus-provider and program-term comparisons
clusters.coverage_basis: /compare/* plus provider-pair guide routes in deployed sitemap
clusters.gap: Depth exists, but the source receipt has no usable demand metric for the head terms. Keep the hub and five-spoke comparison architecture; refresh metrics before allocating more volume.

clusters.name: Insurance, eligibility, coverage, and prior authorization
clusters.coverage_basis: routes containing insurance, prior-authorization, HSA/FSA, or Medicare; overlaps with cost and provider comparisons
clusters.gap: Existing coverage is broad but not drug-specific enough. Add Zepbound coverage and state-plan spokes; keep individualized eligibility and medical decisions out of affiliate copy.

clusters.name: Telehealth provider brands and enrollment terms
clusters.coverage_basis: 28 review routes plus best-provider and intake routes; includes sister-pool review routes and is not a GLP-fit denominator
clusters.gap: The site has review breadth but lacks dedicated, measured brand-term hubs for Ro and Mochi and a systematic provider-brand topic feed. G1 program approval and live-link gates remain authoritative.

clusters.name: Dose, duration, and total-cost math
clusters.gap: The calculator is live, but no measured keyword row exists in the current receipts. Build a pillar plus five explanatory spokes and require the next discovery run to measure dose-cost queries before publishing.

clusters.name: Alternatives, compounded options, and product-status boundaries
clusters.coverage_basis: approved-versus-compounded guide routes; alternatives routes are absent
clusters.gap: There are two approved-versus-compounded explainers but no alternatives pillar or drug-specific alternatives spokes. Legal and FDA status must outrank monetization.

clusters.name: State access, pharmacy availability, and fulfillment
clusters.coverage_basis: availability, online-prescription, pharmacy-verification, product-status, and fulfillment routes; state-specific pages count is zero
clusters.gap: Access explainers exist, but there are zero state-specific coverage/access pages. Build a state-access pillar and five state/fulfillment spokes only after current service-area and source gates pass.

operating_decision: Use hub-and-spoke depth across all ten clusters. The queue schedules two items/day from different clusters, then repeats the same pair pattern for five spoke rounds so each cluster receives one pillar plus five spokes rather than one orphan post.
